name: Celsius Clock
about: Battery-powered ESP32-C3 OLED clock with NTP sync and weather
whatsNew: Reworked OTA update flow: the clock now detects new firmware, shows an update icon, and opens firmware details from GPIO4. Added manual confirmation with hold-to-install, a countdown/progress bar, and install status screens.
notes: Implemented a full OTA discovery and manual install UX with update indicator, details screen, and hold-to-confirm install flow.
